about: The four screenshots handed in with the Leonida Ledger build of the GTA VI Trophy Atlas. Each is a real 1280x800 render of the app served from its own files, with a believable mid-run ledger seeded (thirteen trophies earned, two counters under way).

shots.shows: The cover screen: masthead with the earned count and progress bar, the kind/grade/state filters and the spoiler-shield toggle, the checklist with official names, descriptions and grades, and a trophy guide open in the detail pane with its sources, timing note, confidence badge and three-step breakdown.
The four-stage roadmap to the platinum with per-stage progress drawn from the seeded ledger and a Watch out line on every stage, including the Chapter 1 missable warning in the finale.
The missable watch page: an honest count of exactly one missable trophy out of 55, shown in full with its timing note, guide and spare-save advice.
The Next up planner ranking six recommendations from the seeded progress — missable first, warm counters next, earliest roadmap stage after that — with shielded story names still masked.
